title: smoke_test_v10
objective:
Perform a comprehensive READ-ONLY BunkerGame inspection.

==================================================
1. PROJECT ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Inspect the project structure and determine the current architecture.

Do not modify source.

==================================================
2. GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS
==================================================

Inspect the existing gameplay systems and classify their implementation state.

Do not implement or fix anything.

==================================================
3. WORLD STATE
==================================================

Inspect the current world, bunker, environment, and terrain state.

Do not modify Roblox Studio.
Do not modify terrain.

==================================================
4. ASSET STATE
==================================================

Inspect the currently available assets and their provenance.

Do not generate assets.
Do not import assets.
Do not publish assets.

==================================================
5. UI STATE
==================================================

Inspect the current UI architecture and identify which systems appear connected to gameplay.

Do not modify UI.

==================================================
6. TOOLCHAIN STATE
==================================================

Inspect the current development and QA tooling.

Do not modify Nexus.

==================================================
7. SOURCE OF TRUTH
==================================================

Determine the current relationship between filesystem, Rojo, and Roblox Studio.

Do not synchronize anything.

==================================================
8. FINAL AUDIT
==================================================

Summarize the verified current state.

Every major conclusion must distinguish:
VERIFIED_FACT
INFERENCE
UNKNOWN
STALE_OR_CONFLICTING

Required final markers:

READ_ONLY_AUDIT=PASS
PROJECT_SOURCE_MUTATION=NO
STUDIO_MUTATION=NO
TERRAIN_MUTATION=NO
ASSET_GENERATION=NO
NEXUS_MUTATION=NO
